23.name: Episode 1
23.overview: Dragons' Den returns with an exciting line-up of celebrity guests. In this episode, cosmetic powerhouse Jenna Meek joins Peter Jones, Deborah Meaden, Steven Bartlett and Touker Suleyman.

23.name: Episode 2
23.overview: The pitches in this episode are for skincare made from rescued food, a device that keeps golf balls spotless, an app that helps you to overpay your mortgage and spicy seasoning balls.

23.name: Episode 3
23.overview: Beauty empire founder Susie Ma joins the Dragons to test a set of pitches that comprises a money-saving app, home-baking kits, an AI-powered cat flap and a fresh take on composting toilets.

23.name: Episode 4
23.overview: A cookie business founded by two brother, a mission-led sports events company, an online business with products for limb mobility and a sea-moss-powered wellness brand.

23.name: Episode 5
23.overview: CEO of Refy Beauty, Jenna Meek, returns to the Den. The pitches this time are a phone call-first dating app, a glam makeover to a camping classic, gut-friendly ferments and headphone kits for kids.

23.name: Episode 6
23.overview: In this episode, the pitches are a 'nose-friendly' home composter, a GP with a medical bag redesign, a DIY drinks entrepreneur, and a husband-and-wife team with a pre-loved kitchen business.

23.name: Episode 7
23.overview: The pitches are for an oat-powered snack range, a father-and-son duo's DIY gadget, real-world hide-and-seek adventures, and a sun-shielding lip care range.

23.name: Episode 8
23.overview: The pitches in this episode are water-saving hair care, traditional confectionery, handcrafted spice blends and a mission-led travel start-up.

23.name: Episode 9
23.overview: The pitches to the Dragons are nut-and-seed-based snacks, a gadget for tackling water waste, a vision for upscaling a mural installation business and cricket gear designed to empower girls and women.

23.name: Episode 10
23.overview: The pitches to the Dragons this week are alcohol-liberated wine, music events with social enterprise at their core, a proposal for a new retail venue and all-natural, plant-based ice cream.

23.name: Episode 11
23.overview: The business ideas seeking investment in this episode are miniature golf for your fingers, premium canned seafood, botanical brews and an ethical clothing brand.

23.name: Episode 12
23.overview: The pitches in this episode are a Cumbria-based spelt pasta business, a family-run inflatable pub venture, smart plant sensors and a vegetable-packed instant soup brand.

23.name: Episode 13
23.overview: The pitches to the Dragons are embroidered pet portraits, flat-pack women's urinals, specialist fishing equipment and flavoured pickling liquids.

23.name: Episode 14
23.overview: This time, pitches include turning gift cards to cash, calisthenics for kids, hand-picked hidden escapes, and a husband-and-wife duo offering fairground-style experiences.

overview: Budding entrepreneurs get three minutes to pitch their business ideas to five multi-millionaires willing to invest their own cash.

seasons.name: Series 15
seasons.overview: Dragons' Den is back in business in series 15 with two new multimillionaire investors joining the line-up. Head of the largest vitamin company in the UK Tej Lalvani and ex-banker Jenny Campbell take their seats alongside formidable business giants Deborah Meaden, Peter Jones and Touker Suleyman.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview:
The show allows several entrepreneurs an opportunity to present their varying business ideas to a panel of five wealthy investors, the "Dragons" of the show's title, and pitch for financial investment while offering a stake of the company in return.

Dragons' Den is a British television series, hosted by Evan Davis.
